# ops module

Ops Console backend: unified moderation queue fan-in
(shared/moderation registry) + feature-flag switches.

**Spec pointer:** Sprint2 spec pack D21.

## Boundary rules
- Never import from other modules (import-linter enforces independence);
  cross-module effects go through the Redis Streams event bus
  (shared/events.py, ADR-0008) or the owning module's public service
  interface.
- Every route lives on a SecureRouter (shared/security.py, ADR-0009);
  `public=True` requires updating backend/core/public_routes.txt in the
  same PR.
- IDs are UUIDv7 (ADR-0003); every list endpoint is cursor-paginated
  (shared/pagination.py, ADR-0004) - OFFSET is banned by a test gate.
- User-generated content defaults to `pending` moderation state.

## Never do
- Never log request bodies or query strings - this module fans other modules' pending items into one queue.
  PII scrubbing (shared/telemetry.py) is the last line of defence, not a
  licence.
- Never read another module's tables directly.
- Never bypass rate limiting or add an undeclared public route.
- Never decide or commit on a source's behalf - the
  registered ModerationSource owns its FOR UPDATE service and audit()
  call; this module only sequences commit -> best-effort publish.
- Never flip a flag outside the super_admin gate; a flag flip is a
  business-level act.
